description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayEndpointID functionality within the OpenClaw project. It tests the decoding and normalization of service identifiers and the proper decoding of Bonjour-style escaped names.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointIDTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for GatewayEndpointID functions related to network endpoint identifiers.

methods.name: stableIDForServiceDecodesAndNormalizesName
methods.description: Tests decoding and normalization of service endpoint names, ensuring escapes are handled and the ID format is correct.

methods.name: stableIDForNonServiceUsesEndpointDescription
methods.description: Tests that non-service endpoints use their descriptive string as the stable ID.

methods.name: prettyDescriptionDecodesBonjourEscapes
methods.description: Ensures that Bonjour escape sequences are correctly decoded in the pretty description output.
